# Pada Design System

> Pada (`pada-ds`) is a React design system written in TypeScript: components, CSS design tokens, and light/dark theming. It needs `react` and `react-dom` 19 as peer dependencies.

## Install

```bash
npm install pada-ds
```

## Usage

Import the tokens and the component styles once at the app root, then import components by name from the package root:

```tsx
import 'pada-ds/tokens.css';
import 'pada-ds/styles.css';
import { Button } from 'pada-ds';

<Button variant="primary">Save</Button>
```

- `pada-ds/tokens.css`: design tokens (CSS custom properties) only.
- `pada-ds/styles.css`: styles for every component.
- `pada-ds/base.css` (optional): document base styles (`body` background, color and font; zero `p` margins).
- `pada-ds/manifest.json`: machine-readable component API (props, types, defaults, descriptions).

## Theming

By default the theme follows the operating system (`prefers-color-scheme`). Set `data-theme="light"` or `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>` or on any container to force a theme for that subtree. Remove the attribute to follow the OS again.

## Components

Every component is a named export: `import { Name } from 'pada-ds'`. Props marked `?` are optional. Full prop tables with types, defaults and examples are in llms-full.txt.

- Accordion: header, headerIconName?, children, defaultOpen?, open?, onOpenChange?, className?, disabled?
- AccordionContent: children; extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
- AccordionHeader: title, iconName?, collapsed?; extends Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'title'>
- Banner: title, subtitle?, visualIcon?, visualImage?, visualAlt?, button?, onButtonClick?, className?
- BaseManageFilter: saveCopy?, onSaveFilter?, onClear?, onMenuClick?, className?
- BaseToolbarMenu: title?, count?, showCount?, dropdown?, disabled?, state?, className?, onClick?
- Button: children?, variant?, leftIcon?, rightIcon?, split?, onSplitClick?, disabled?; extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>
- Card: children?, className?
- Carousel: children, autoPlay?, interval?, className?, showDots?, showNav?
- Checkbox: label?; extends React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>
- CodeSnippet: code, language, type?, label?, showCopy?, className?
- ComboBox: items, multiSelect?, onItemClick?; extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
- ComboBoxMenuItem: iconName?, label, selected?, disabled?, multiSelect?; extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>
- DatePickerDropdown: mode?, selection?, isRange?, value?, onChange?, minDate?, maxDate?
- Filter: label, options, multiSelect?, value?, defaultValue?, onChange?, applyLabel?, clearLabel?, disabled?, className?
- FilterChip: variant?, label?, value?, showClose?, disabled?, onRemove?, onClick?, className?
- FormLabel: children, required?, optional?, htmlFor?; extends React.LabelHTMLAttributes<HTMLLabelElement>
- HeaderCell: columnId, label, className?
- Icon: name?, src?, size?, color?, variant?; extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
- Indexer: items, activeIndex?, offset?, onActiveChange?; extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>
- InputDate: label?, error?, description?, required?, optional?, disabled?, placeholder?, filled?, mode?, selection?, value?, onChange?, minDate?, maxDate?, className?
- InputText: label?, error?, description?, prefix?, suffix?, required?, optional?; extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'prefix' | 'suffix'>
- InputTextArea: label?, error?, description?, required?, optional?; extends React.TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>
- KeyValue: label, children, infoTooltip?, labelComponent?; extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
- List: children, draggable?, className?, onReorder?
- ListItem: id?, children, className?
- Loader: size?, className?
- Logo: name, size?, background?, tooltip?; extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
- Modal: open, onOpenChange, children, title?, width?, height?
- MoreFilter: label?, filters, value?, defaultValue?, onChange?, applyLabel?, clearLabel?, disabled?, className?
- Notification: open, onOpenChange, title, subtitle?, visual?, position?, direction?, className?
- PageHeader: breadcrumbs, onCommandClick?, commandLabel?, commandShortcut?, onAiClick?, aiLabel?, profileTrigger?, profileMenu?, className?
- Pills: options, value?, defaultValue?, onChange?, className?, size?, disabled?
- Popover: open, onOpenChange, children, trigger?, position?, title?, variant?, showClose?, className?, clickPosition?
- Progress: value, max?, label?
- RadioGroup: name, label?, options, value, onChange, disabled?, className?
- SearchField: value?, defaultValue?, onChange?, onClear?, className?; extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'size' | 'onChange' | 'value' | 'defaultValue'>
- SegmentControl: options, value?, defaultValue?, onChange?, className?, disabled?
- Select: label, options, value?, defaultValue?, placeholder?, onChange?, description?, error?, disabled?, name?, id?, className?
- SideDrawer: open, onOpenChange, children, size?, className?
- Sidebar: data?, activeId?, onItemClick?, children?, className?; extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>
- SidebarCollapse: children, defaultOpen?, label?, className?
- SidebarLogo: src?, alt?, name?, size?, title?, href?, onClick?, className?; extends Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'title'>
- SidebarMenu: label, icon?, selected?, trailing?, href?, onClick?, disabled?, className?; extends Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'onClick'>
- SidebarSearch: placeholder?, value?, onChange?, className?
- SidebarSection: label?, icon?, children?, className?; extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
- SidebarSectionMenu: children, className?
- Slider: label?, description?, error?, value?, defaultValue?, min?, max?, step?, onChange?, onValueChange?, showValue?, disabled?, className?; extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'type' | 'onChange'>
- Splitter: variant; extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>
- Step: title?, description?, stepValue?, status?, isLast?, onClick?, clickable?, onSelect?; extends Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'onClick' | 'onSelect'>
- Steps: steps, defaultStatus?, currentStep?, onStepChange?; extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
- Switch: label?, loading?; extends React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>
- TabPanel: label, children, notification?
- Table: columns, children, toolbar?, className?, onColumnsChange?
- TableCell: children, columnId?, className?
- TablePagination: total, page, rowsPerPage, rowsPerPageOptions?, onPageChange, onRowsPerPageChange, onNextPage?, onPrevPage?, className?
- TableRow: children, className?, selected?, onClick?, role?
- Tabs: children, label, defaultValue?, value?, onChange?
- Tags: children, variant?, icon?, className?
- Text: children, size?, weight?, family?, lineHeight?, color?, as?; extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>
- Toolbar: left?, actions?, primaryAction?, children?, className?
- Tooltip: content, children, position?
- UploadField: label?, description?, error?, accept?, multiple?, maxSize?, maxFiles?, files?, onFilesChange?, onUpload?, disabled?, required?, className?
